name: Product Brief (fan-out → synthesis)
description: Three specialists research a product idea in parallel, then one synthesis step fans them in. A diamond DAG that shows fan-out and fan-in in one run. (Candidate for PS-3 arena mode on the 'synthesis' step once promoted.)

steps.title: Market analysis: {{idea}}
steps.description: Analyze the market for "{{idea}}": size, trends, top 3 competitors, and the key differentiator opportunity. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Technical feasibility: {{idea}}
steps.description: Assess technical feasibility of "{{idea}}": core components, hardest engineering risk, and a rough build sequence. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Risk & compliance: {{idea}}
steps.description: Identify the top legal, compliance, and business risks for "{{idea}}" and how to mitigate each. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Synthesize the {{idea}} brief
steps.description: Combine the market, technical, and risk inputs into a single one-page product brief with a clear go / no-go recommendation. Output as markdown.
